body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adds comprehensive architecture documentation for ObjectStack's microkernel architecture, including three major new documentation files and updates to existing documentation.

**Changes:**
- Created ARCHITECTURE.md (661 lines) - comprehensive microkernel architecture overview with design principles, package structure, and dependency graph
- Created PACKAGE-DEPENDENCIES.md (313 lines) - detailed dependency analysis with 6-layer hierarchy, dependency matrix, and build order
- Created QUICK-REFERENCE.md (253 lines) - developer quick reference with common tasks, naming conventions, and import patterns
- Updated README.md with organized package structure into 6 categories and cross-references to architecture documentation
- Enhanced micro-kernel.mdx with expanded plugin documentation, lifecycle details, and API information
- Minor .gitignore update for documentation build artifacts

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ARCHITECTURE.md | Comprehensive architecture documentation covering microkernel design, 12-package structure, three-layer protocol stack, plugin system, dependency rules, and design decisions |
| PACKAGE-DEPENDENCIES.md | Detailed dependency graph visualization with 6-layer hierarchy, dependency matrix, build order, and external dependency analysis |
| QUICK-REFERENCE.md | Quick reference guide with package overview, common tasks, plugin templates, standard events, logger usage, and import patterns |
| README.md | Reorganized package structure into 6 categories (Core, Engine, Client, Plugin, Tools, Examples) with enhanced descriptions and architecture documentation links |
| content/docs/developers/micro-kernel.mdx | Enhanced plugin documentation with detailed lifecycle, naming conventions, built-in plugin specifications, and expanded API documentation |
| .gitignore | Added exclusions for documentation build artifacts (docs/ directory) |
</details>

The `init` method is not optional in the actual Plugin interface (see `packages/core/src/types.ts:87`). The interface requires `init` to be implemented, while `start` and `destroy` are optional. The documentation should reflect this accurately.

The documented logger.error signature shows `logger.error(message, metadata?)` but the actual Logger interface (packages/core/src/contracts/logger.ts:35) defines it as `error(message: string, error?: Error, meta?: Record<string, any>): void`. The documentation should reflect the actual signature with the error parameter between message and metadata.
```suggestion
logger.debug(message, metadata?)             // Development/troubleshooting
logger.info(message, metadata?)              // General information
logger.warn(message, metadata?)              // Warnings
logger.error(message, error?, metadata?)     // Errors
logger.fatal(message, metadata?)             // Fatal errors
```

The documented logger.fatal signature should also include the error parameter like the Logger interface defines: `fatal(message: string, error?: Error, meta?: Record<string, any>): void` (see packages/core/src/contracts/logger.ts:43). The documentation shows `logger.fatal(message, metadata?)` which is missing the error parameter.
```suggestion
logger.debug(message, metadata?)             // Development/troubleshooting
logger.info(message, metadata?)              // General information
logger.warn(message, metadata?)              // Warnings
logger.error(message, metadata?)             // Errors
logger.fatal(message, error?, metadata?)     // Fatal errors
```

The documented plugin name format `com.objectstack.app.{name}` doesn't match the actual implementation in packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:24, which uses `plugin.app.${appId}`. The documentation should reflect the actual naming convention used in the code.
```suggestion
**Name**: `plugin.app.{name}`  
```

The documented plugin name format `com.objectstack.app.{name}` doesn't match the actual implementation in packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:24, which uses `plugin.app.${appId}`. The documentation should reflect the actual naming convention used in the code.
```suggestion
**Name**: `plugin.app.{appId}`  
```

The documented plugin name `com.objectstack.plugin.hono-server` doesn't match the actual implementation in packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/hono-plugin.ts:17, which uses `com.objectstack.server.hono`. The documentation should reflect the actual plugin name used in the code.
```suggestion
**Name**: `com.objectstack.server.hono`  
```
